from: June book, night 27 (Hear Thou in Heaven)
p1: King Solomon stood before the people at the temple. He spread his hands toward heaven and prayed.
He said, “Lord, there is no one like You, in heaven or on earth. You keep Your promises.” Solomon knew even the whole sky could not hold the Lord.
He asked, “When Your people pray toward this house, hear them in heaven. And when You hear, forgive.” To forgive is to take a wrong away.
p2: Solomon prayed on his knees, with hands up high. Then he stood and blessed the people. He said, “The Lord be with us. May He never leave us.”
Heavenly Father hears your prayers. Tonight, fold your arms and pray for people you love.
old: When the temple was finished, Solomon gathered ALL of Israel together. He stood in front of the new temple. It was time to dedicate it to Heavenly Father!
Solomon knelt down. He spread out his hands toward heaven. He prayed a beautiful prayer: “Heavenly Father, when Your people pray here, please HEAR them!”
Solomon prayed for everyone — for the people of Israel, for strangers visiting from far away, even for people who would pray years later. He asked God to hear ALL their prayers!
When Solomon finished praying, a bright cloud filled the temple! Everyone knew Heavenly Father had heard the prayer. He was there!
